blurb: Anchorage Boat Dock is a family owned and operated marina located on the north end of Lake Burton at the head of Timpson Creek. They offer boat rentals, repairs, sales, a marina store, a restaurant called Take It On the Lake, a live bait shop, and wet and dry slip rentals. The marina operates daily from Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day weekend, 8am to 6pm.
